verdict.rationale: Morph publishes specific throughput numbers (10,500+ tok/s Fast Apply, 33,000 tok/s Compact, 90ms classifiers, 30s Reflex training) across its docs and even one independent community post corroborates a speed/iteration boost, but there is no independent benchmark suite, third-party load-testing report, or reproducible methodology, and one community report describes inaccurate output rather than confirming throughput. missing for 10: independent benchmark/load-testing reports, published methodology or test conditions behind the tok/s figures, and resolution of the community accuracy complaint.
